limits.en: Free monthly allowances vary by API, e.g. up to 50,000 Mapbox GL JS map loads, 25,000 monthly active users on Maps SDKs, 100,000 geocoding requests.

keyLimits.en: Free monthly allowances vary by API, e.g. up to 50,000 Mapbox GL JS map loads, 25,000 MAU on Maps SDKs, 100,000 geocoding requests.

cautions.en: Pricing is pay-as-you-go per API (Maps SDK, GL JS, Directions, Geocoding, etc.), each with its own free allowance and volume-discounted tiers past it; there is no single flat plan price.
Traffic Data, Movement Data and Boundaries products require custom licensing, sold on quote only.

capabilities.en: Customizable web and mobile map rendering (Mapbox GL JS, Maps SDKs for iOS/Android).
Geocoding, directions/navigation and static image generation APIs.

limitations.en: No flat subscription; cost scales with usage and can become unpredictable at scale without monitoring.
High-value geospatial datasets (traffic, movement, boundaries) are not self-serve and require a sales conversation.

reason.en: Direct competitor for map rendering, geocoding and directions APIs.

missingAlternatives.name: MapTiler
missingAlternatives.reason: Usage-based map/geocoding API competitor not in the catalogue

missingAlternatives.name: OpenStreetMap / Leaflet ecosystem
missingAlternatives.reason: Free open-data alternative frequently compared to Mapbox

unknowns: Exact free-tier allowance and unit price for every Mapbox API were not enumerated; only representative examples (Maps SDK, Directions) were captured within the page-budget.
No entry-level flat paid plan exists, so a single comparePriceMonthly figure cannot be derived without an assumed usage volume.
